name: Star Squadrons: Galactic Trading Card Game
detailed_description:
Play the free Star Squadrons premium demo on Steam late 2025 and join our bold new community as we rewrite TCG history together!

Be the commander of your own star squadron and dive into high-stakes sci-fi card skirmishes. Star Squadrons shreds every trading-card-game convention:

  • No Mana—Maximum Interaction
    Play any card at any time—no resource grind, no downtime, no long waits for your opponent.

  • Ever-Shifting Battlefields
    Five new Location cards each month—adapt your tactics and compete with the best.

  • Pick Your Opening Hand & Seize the First Strike
    No more flat starts: grab the perfect cards, outbid your rival with Command Points, and unleash the opening volley!

  • Shape the Game Together
    Test and suggest new mechanics and factions, earn physical Early Release promo cards in online rankings, join livestreams, raffles, and local events.

Born from a Star Citizen fan project by indie designer Thomas, Star Squadrons now readies its demo ahead of a major 2026 Kickstarter and commercial launch.

Our Vision: Bridge the digital and physical card game worlds for the first time—cross-platform play with real-world tournament player progress, novel social features, and a positive community where every player finds their place.

short_description: Play first. Decide later. Star Squadrons rewrites Trading Card Game history: no mana, no paywalls, nonstop interaction, and self-picked starting hands. Experience the full game — free on Steam starting late 2025. Two complete decks, zero restrictions. Kickstarter coming 2026!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X or Equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600X or Equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
